snippet.title: Eragon's Tale - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Eragon's Tale is a horror adventure game that follows the story of Eragon, a young lad of a noble family. During the party celebrating the passing of the family elder, an artifact of great value is stolen. Soon after, Eragon starts seeing nightmares, and somehow these two events are intertwined...

Wishlist on Steam now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1929630/Eragons_Tale/

Links: https://talehammer.carrd.co/ 
For Evelyn II: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2248960/For_Evelyn_II__Shards_of_Creation/ 
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/TaleHammer 
Twitter: https://x.com/Tale_Hammer

Song by Nicolas Gasparini (Myuu) https://www.thedarkpiano.com/
